budget.max_utf8_bytes: nonnegative integer rendered-context budget including separators

supplied_graphs_or_units: Rejected by exact input schema. All units, edges and scopes are extracted from excerpt text independently.
offsets: Unicode codepoint half-open [start,end); span objects also contain exact text and derived source_byte_start/source_byte_end UTF-8 offsets. Preserve all original bytes and internal whitespace; no Unicode or newline normalization.
markers: Line start after optional horizontal whitespace: numeric 1. or 1), dotted numeric 2.1 or 2.1.3 with optional final period or right parenthesis; marker followed by horizontal whitespace or line end.
Case-insensitive Section prefix is supported before a numeric marker; Section 2 without final period is supported.
Line-start parenthesized single lowercase letter (a)..(z) requires a preceding active numeric marker. (i), (v), (x) are letters; no Roman-intent inference.
A dotted numeric marker requires an earlier unique exact numeric prefix parent, e.g. 2.1 requires 2. Missing or duplicate parent emits ambiguous_scope; the numbered unit is retained with null parent.
Single uppercase letters, multi-letter parentheses, and letter-plus-period/right-parenthesis markers are suspicious unsupported boundaries. They create no unit and reset active numeric scope.

boundaries.whole: Start at first marker character after indentation, including Section prefix if present. End at the next recognized or suspicious marker's line start, or excerpt end, with trailing whitespace stripped. Internal continuation whitespace and newlines remain literal.
boundaries.marker: Start as whole; end immediately after the marker token/delimiter, excluding following whitespace.
boundaries.content: Start after the marker and following horizontal whitespace, capped at whole end. End equals whole end.
boundaries.parent_scope: Letter children require the active numeric unit; dotted children require their earlier unique numeric parent. This direct structural parent edge is emitted whether or not the parent ends in a colon.
boundaries.heading_span: If parent content ends in a colon, its last nonblank content line (without leading horizontal whitespace) is an inherited heading span. Ancestor heading spans are inherited in order. The heading remains inside the parent unit.
boundaries.inherited_references: A reference in a parent creates only the parent-to-target edge. Child closure follows its direct parent edge; no duplicate child-to-reference-target edge/reference is emitted.
boundaries.preamble: Retain original source but create no invented unit. Colon lines before the first boundary emit ambiguous_scope/unnumbered_heading. No guessed standalone heading applicability.
boundaries.empty_source_structure: No supported units creates an explicit no_supported_units structural unknown.

ids: Excerpt ID + '::' + canonical clause label. Numbered labels retain numeric spelling; letter labels append to active numeric label, e.g. x::2(a). Repeated canonical labels use #2, #3 occurrence suffixes. All occurrences receive ambiguous_scope/duplicate_clause_id, even without references.

case_insensitive_triggers: on condition that the requirements of
reference_grammar.absolute: Section/Sections/Clause/Clauses + numeric path optionally followed by one lowercase parenthesized letter. Match targets only in the same excerpt; forward references supported.
reference_grammar.relative: A bare lowercase (a) after a trigger resolves against the containing unit's active numeric scope, never a global nearest match.
reference_grammar.lists: Numeric targets after a shared explicit prefix may be separated by comma, comma-and, or and. Relative targets may form lists of bare letters. Every member gets a separate reference; no inference of omitted numeric parents, e.g. Section 2(a) and (b) is unsupported for the whole trigger.
reference_grammar.target_span: Numeric/letter target token ONLY, e.g. '2(a)' or '(a)'; excludes Section/Clause prefix and separators.
reference_grammar.trigger_span: Exact supported trigger words including original internal whitespace, excludes following whitespace.
reference_grammar.unsupported: Ranges/dashes/through/to-number, or-lists, missing supported target, herein/above/below/foregoing, external schedules/exhibits, and omitted numeric parents produce unsupported_reference_syntax and no resolved edge for that trigger.
reference_grammar.unknown_span: Unsupported reference: trigger start through last parsed target end when present, otherwise min(unit.end,trigger.end+80). Missing/ambiguous target: target token span. Unsupported marker/orphan letter: marker start through that segment's whitespace-trimmed end. Missing/duplicate numeric ancestor and duplicate label: marker token span only. Unnumbered preamble heading: entire colon line including indentation/trailing horizontal whitespace, excluding newline. Budget exceeded: [0,0). No supported units: [0,len(text)).
reference_grammar.duplicate: Multiple excerpt-local canonical targets => ambiguous_reference, with candidate IDs in source order.
reference_grammar.edge: Containing unit requires the target. Direct parent dependencies precede references; final requires is unique and source-ordered.

parser_result.units: Insertion-ordered object keyed by ID. Each row: id,clause_id,excerpt_id,start,end,marker_start,marker_end,content_start,content_end,parent_id,requires,heading_spans,numeric_scope,marker_span,content_span,whole_span.
parser_result.unknowns: Array with excerpt_id,owner_id (nullable),reason,span plus optional detail or candidate_ids. Sorted within excerpt by span start,end,reason,owner ID; excerpts remain input ordered.
parser_result.cycles: Sorted array of sorted unit-ID arrays, one per cyclic strongly connected component; self-loops count. Cycles are retained, not errors, and closure is visited-set safe.
parser_result.valid: Input/schema validity only. Structural unknowns do not invalidate other extracted units. Errors prevent native retrieval for the case.

packing.ordering: Excerpt input order, then start,end,ID. Merge touching/overlapping selected spans within excerpt, join merged spans by one literal LF; never rewrite excerpt text.
packing.closure: Cycle-safe transitive closure over automatically extracted direct requires. Admit each seed's whole component atomically under identical max_nodes/max_utf8_bytes budget.
packing.baseline: Same exact effective seed list, closure disabled; same rendering, budgets and sort policy.
packing.unknown: Selected-owner structural unknown or owner=null unknown, dropped component, missing dependency, invalid input/seed, or empty effective seeds remains structural unknown.
packing.semantic_labels: Never emitted. entailment_or_insufficiency_decision=NOT_EVALUATED, global_evidence_completeness=UNKNOWN; retrieval miss never means insufficient evidence.

workers: One shared deterministic parser. Actual native RuVector/BGE search over parser-extracted unit texts; lexical Jaccard and positional controls. Baseline/closure within each arm use the exact same effective seeds. No arm-specific parsing or dependency inference.
claims: Newly authored CC0 structural engineering fixtures only; no NLI, semantic benchmark gain, SOTA, or synthetic-generalization claim.
execution: No candidate/model/native execution before source freeze and exact remote admission; one nonretryable batch, at most 2 CPU and 600 seconds.
